cmd.setup: Set up the Python environment (install muse2api)
cmd.useModel: Set model as the active Kilo Code model
cfg.driver:
muse2api upstream driver.

- `browser`: real muse.ai accounts through Chromium (import cookies)
- `mock`: offline demo without an account (for trying things out)
- `http`: direct protocol, not implemented upstream yet (501)
cfg.autoPort: Use the next free port automatically when the configured one is taken.
cfg.pythonPath: Path to Python >= 3.10. Empty = auto-detect (`python3`, `python`, `py -3.x`, common locations).
cfg.dataDir: Gateway data folder (accounts, keys, media, browser profile). Empty = extension global storage.
cfg.apiKey: Fixed API key for `/v1/*`. Empty = muse2api generates one and stores it in the data folder.
cfg.adminKey: Admin key for `/admin/*` and the dashboard. Empty = same as the API key.
cfg.autoStart: Start the gateway automatically once VS Code finished starting up.
cfg.chromiumPath: Path to Chrome/Chromium for the browser driver. Empty = auto-detect.
cfg.headless: Run the browser driver without a visible window.
cfg.accountConcurrency: Parallel requests per muse.ai account (browser tabs).
cfg.streamHeartbeat: SSE keepalive interval in seconds, `0` = off. Helps when proxies drop idle streams.
cfg.shimEnabled: Put the local tool-call shim in front of the gateway. muse.ai has no native function calling; the shim translates Kilo Code's `tools` into a text protocol and turns `<tool_use>` replies back into OpenAI `tool_calls`. Without it only Ask/chat modes work.
cfg.shimPort: Shim port (this is the base URL registered in Kilo Code).
cfg.maxToolResultChars: Tool results are truncated to this length before they are sent to muse.ai.
cfg.providerId: Provider id in Kilo Code (`provider.<id>` in kilo.jsonc). Lowercase letters, digits, `-`, `_` only.
cfg.displayName: Provider display name in Kilo Code.
cfg.scope: Default registration target: the global Kilo Code config or the workspace `.kilo/kilo.jsonc`. You are still asked when registering.
cfg.contextWindow: Context window (tokens) Kilo Code assumes for these models.
cfg.maxOutputTokens: Maximum output tokens Kilo Code assumes for these models.
cfg.declareToolCalls: Declare the models as `tool_call: true` in Kilo Code (default, so agent modes use the tool-call shim). Set to `false` when `muse2api.shim.enabled` is off – muse.ai itself has no native function calling.
cfg.declareImages: Declare image input (`modalities.input: [text, image]`). muse2api forwards images to the chat.
cfg.includeNonChatModels: Also add `muse-image` and `muse-video` to Kilo Code's model picker. Those models cannot chat there – prefer the "Generate image"/"Generate video" commands.
cfg.setAsActiveModel: Set the muse model as the active Kilo Code model after registering (`model` in kilo.jsonc).
cfg.writeKeyToAuthStore: Also store the API key in Kilo Code's `auth.json` (exactly like its "Custom provider" dialog). Otherwise use `options.apiKey` or enter it in the UI.
cfg.useUv: Use `uv` for the venv and the install when it is on PATH (much faster than pip).
